verdict.rationale: Perplexity provides an OpenAI-compatible Agent API with structured JSON output, model fallback, sandboxed code execution, and reusable profiles, plus a dedicated `pplx` CLI explicitly designed for shell pipelines and coding agents that need current web results — all suitable for headless/CI automation. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on report confirming real-world CI pipeline usage, and no documented rate-limit/quota guidance specifically for automated batch workloads.
